items.name: Benoni May Madness 2026
items.information:
**CubingZA** is excited to announce Benoni May Madness 2026!! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens.

We will be having an odd mix of main, side and blind events in this One Day, One Stop, All-Out Total Non-Stop Action-Based Competition so be sure to stick around for all sorts of weird and unique tastes of skill, fortitude and perseverance!! 




**All New Competitors**
If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. 


**Food and Drinks**
Mova Coffee and Sweet N' Sweet will be available from the morning selling food and drinks. They will be around for the duration of the competition so be sure to get your food in between rounds and during lunch because part of being your own champion is competing at your best and not on an empty stomach!!!

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaFJUIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8e2d7b91fc538ebb9ebe9ee02ad47675480d6e5f/asa_nuevo_small.png)](https://www.instagram.com/asa_speedcubing/)

---

📚 ¡Te damos la bienvenida al primer torneo oficial en Argentina con clases especializadas!

- 🧑‍🎓 Recomendamos saber armar el Cubo de Rubik antes de asistir
- 🏫 Mirá el temario y qué esperar [EN ESTA PESTAÑA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClasesdeFMCBAI2026#74559-temario-de-clases-lecture-topics)
- ❗ FMC se compite por escrito, no por velocidad. Es un desafío más avanzado que armarlo normalmente
- ⚠️ **No explicaremos cómo resolver el Cubo de Rubik desde cero, o cómo resolverlo más rápido**

**POR FAVOR LEER LA PESTAÑA ["IMPORTANTE"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClasesdeFMCBAI2026#74558-importante-important) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE**

---

📚 Welcome to the first competition in Argentina featuring specialized classes!

- 🧑‍🎓 We recommend that you know how to solve a Rubik's Cube before attending these classes
- 🏫 Check out the list of topics and what to expect [IN THIS TAB](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClasesdeFMCBAI2026#74559-temario-de-clases-lecture-topics)
- ❗ FMC is competed in writing, not by speed. It is an advanced challenge compared to regular solving
- ⚠️ **We will not be explaining how to solve the Rubik's Cube from scratch, or how to solve it faster**

**PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClasesdeFMCBAI2026#74558-importante-important) TAB IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY**

items.name: Evanston Qualifier 2026
items.information:
**3x3 will *not* be held at this competition!**

This competition provides one last chance to set qualifying times for the [WCA North American Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026) in July. Please read all tabs before registering. If you have not been to Northwestern before, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue.

Each competitor may register for at most 6 events.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).

venue.name: Business Club 5
venue.details: Natjecanje će biti održano na 14. katu zgrade. / Competition will be held at the 14th floor.

items.information:
[HR]

Zagreb Cubing Series I. 2026 je natjecanje na kojemu se pretežito održavaju discipline velikih kocaka te side evenata. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost.

**NAPOMENA - NA OVOM NATJECANJU SE NEĆE ODRŽATI KLASIČNE DISCIPLINE KAO NPR. 3X3X3 KOCKA**

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije natjecanja. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska.

Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja.

[EN]

Zagreb Cubing Series I. 2026 is a competition which mostly holds big cubes and side events. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are.

**NOTE - THIS COMPETITION WILL NOT HOLD COMMON EVENTS LIKE THE 3X3X3 CUBE**

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the competition organization. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.

For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.
